acceptance_criteria: Written consent precedes every installation, with no exceptions.
Published data aggregates by street or larger; no address is ever identifiable.

escalation_conditions: A parent, school or homeowner objects.
Any activity would require entering restricted land.

nodes.objective: Write the consent and safety protocol before collecting anything: written homeowner consent, parental consent, school district permission, and a data policy that never publishes an address.
nodes.rationale: A minor collecting and publishing measurements about identifiable neighbours' homes is the one way this project goes wrong. Doing this first is not bureaucracy; it is what makes the project defensible and, incidentally, what will impress a judge.
nodes.rollback: Revert the node commit. No external effect to undo.
nodes.stopping_condition: Protocol written and co-signed by a responsible adult.

notes: The youth track is deliberately independent of the venture track so a student is never blocked on it.
YM-010 precedes YM-020 on purpose: the protocol is written before the first sensor is built.
A no-launch window is a documented result, not a failure. YM-040 says so.

risk_gates.YM-010: Consent and safety come before any data collection. No exceptions.
